First, note that time zones as we know them didn’t exist in 1322.  
But for the sake of the exercise, we’ll use modern time zone offsets:  
Europe/Athens = EET (UTC+2) in March (no DST in 1322).  
Australia/Sydney = AEDT (UTC+11) in March (no DST in 1322 either).  

Time difference = UTC+11 − UTC+2 = +9 hours.  

10:00 Athens + 9 hours = 19:00 same day (March 7, 1322) in Sydney.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1322-03-07 19:00
